name: The Open Door
description: The Dene Barrow's door has stood open for six hundred years and never once mattered. Something about that has changed.

stages.name: Go and look
stages.description: Hedda says the draught has turned. Air used to go in.

objectives.description: Climb the sheep field to the barrow.

stages.name: Whatever came out
stages.description: It has been down to the village twice.

objectives.description: Put down what has come out of the mound.

stages.name: Tell somebody who will listen
stages.description: Hedda will know who that is.

objectives.description: Tell Hedda what is in the barrow.
